Das Portfolio ist dabei auf den Kommunikationsbedarf von Geschäfts- und Privatkunden ausgerichtet und reicht von Sprach- und Datendiensten – auf Festnetz- sowie Mobilfunk-Basis – über komplexe Standortvernetzungen bis hin zur Bereitstellung eines breiten nationalen und internationalen Radio- und TV-/HDTV-Angebots. Der Klimawandel gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Um ihn aufzuhalten, braucht es den Einsatz von uns allen. Unsere Ärmel sind bereits hochgekrempelt: In den letzten Jahren haben wir hinter den Kulissen intensiv an unserer eigenen Klimabilanz gearbeitet, Stellschrauben gedreht und aus Worten Taten gemacht. Den größten Teil haben wir bereits aus eigener Kraft geschafft und 90 Prozent unserer Treibhausgas-Emissionen mit umfassenden Maßnahmen reduziert. Die restlichen 10 Prozent kompensieren wir derzeit nach hohem Standard über ClimatePartner. Heute setzen wir als Deutschlands erster klimaneutraler Telekommunikationsanbieter ein Zeichen und helfen mit, in eine bessere Zukunft zu steuern. Für unseren Standort in München suchen wir im Bereich Finanzen, Beschaffung & Business Intelligence zum 01.01.2027 eine/n Senior Einkäufer (m/w/d) . Aufgaben Die wirtschaftliche Beschaffung und zeitgerechte Bereitstellung von Vorleistungen ist erfolgskritischer denn je, deshalb möchten wir unser Einkaufsteam mit Ihnen verstärken! Als erfahrener Senior Einkäufer (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie dabei eine zentrale Rolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit, die den Unternehmenserfolg von M-net nachhaltig sichern soll. review_candidates.title: Senior Associate/Manager, Latin America and the Caribbean
review_candidates.description: Location: Mexico City, Bogota, Sao Paulo, Or Major Business Centre in the Region Application Deadline: November 23, 2026 Convergence is the global network for blended finance. Blended finance is the use of catalytic public or philanthropic capital to increase private sector investment in places that need it most. We are the source for everything blended finance, including deals, data, reports, trainings, webinars, and much more. At Convergence, we believe that blended finance can disrupt traditional development finance as we know it, by attracting private sector funds to developing countries in volumes never before seen. Convergence is a not-for-profit headquartered in Toronto, Canada. We operate globally and have a presence in Singapore, Nairobi, London, and Washington DC. Over the last decade, we have built a robust network of over 200 public, private, and philanthropic investors as well as sponsors of blended finance transactions. To accelerate advances in the field, Convergence also provides grants, recoverable grants and wraparound support through its Blended Finance Accelerator program, which funds the development of new blended finance solutions. We are small but mighty. Join us if you want to be part of a global and energetic team with a unique role at the intersection of development and finance. We are passionate about and united around the goal of directing money to where it’s needed most – into emerging markets and developing economies and towards achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). We have built a culture defined by our diversity, inclusivity, and ability to get things done. As part of our nimble organization, you can be sure that you’ll have a voice and leave your mark. Finally, we take our team members’ growth and well-being seriously, so we offer opportunities for professional development and team building as well as flexible schedules and generous time off policies. Convergence has built a strong network of relationships across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and seeks to further expand its regional presence. The Senior Associate / Manager will help execute Convergence’s regional strategy by managing institutional relationships, developing membership and partnership opportunities, and supporting capacity building and blended finance initiatives. We are looking for someone with strong experience in client service, business development, and/or relationship and account management, with a good understanding of finance, banking, and capital markets. The role will also contribute to Convergence’s global membership platform, drawing on direct engagement with members to improve their experience, increase platform adoption, and inform new products and features. The position will be based in Mexico City, Bogotá, São Paulo, or another major business center in the region and will work closely with colleagues globally. Position Description The Senior Associate / Manager will help grow Convergence’s network and strengthen the value we provide to members and partners. Approximately 75% of the role will focus on regional relationship management, partnerships, capacity building, and Blended Finance Accelerator activities. The remaining 25% will support global member engagement and platform development. Working Closely Across The Convergence Team, You Will Develop and manage institutional relationships, grow membership, and cultivate partnerships across LAC. Develop and deliver capacity building programs and regional content on blended finance. Identify and support a regional pipeline of blended finance projects, companies, and funds seeking capital, including through Convergence’s Blended Finance Accelerator. Strengthen member engagement and platform uptake, using feedback and data to inform outreach, improve the member experience, and shape new products and features. Responsibilities The following comprise the core responsibilities of the Senior Associate / Manager. The scope will evolve to reflect regional needs and organizational priorities. Regional Relationships, Partnerships, and Program Delivery — 75% Support the execution of Convergence’s LAC strategy, deepening our regional presence and building a strong network across the private, public, and philanthropic sectors. Manage institutional member relationships as the primary regional point of contact, strengthening engagement, identifying partnership opportunities, and supporting retention. Identify prospective members in target markets and lead outreach, conversion, and onboarding, helping new members understand and use Convergence’s platform and services. Develop membership and partnership opportunities, including preparing proposals, marketing materials, and briefing notes in collaboration with colleagues. Develop and deliver tailored in-person and virtual training, capacity building, and knowledge sharing sessions that respond to regional stakeholder needs. Contribute to LAC-focused research, articles, and other content in collaboration with Market Insights and regional partners, bringing member perspectives and market needs into Convergence’s work. Support Blended Finance Accelerator activities in the region, including pipeline generation, proposal review, due diligence, program coordination, and preparation of materials for funding decisions. Identify opportunities to connect regional members and partners with relevant investors, transactions, programs, and platform offerings. Global Member Engagement and Platform Development — 25% Develop deep expertise in Convergence’s membership platform, support colleagues and members with technical inquiries, and identify improvements to the member experience. Analyze platform usage and member engagement data, track key metrics, and use findings to inform targeted outreach, retention, and growth opportunities. Coordinate and collaborate with the compliance team to ensure timely onboarding and approval of new members and transactions. Support global member communications and feedback gathering, translating insights from regional and global engagement into recommendations for platform improvements. Help develop and implement user growth strategies and partnerships to expand platform adoption, working with Engagement, Market Insights, Technology, and other teams to shape, roll out, and refine new products and features. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred. 5–7 years of relevant experience for the Manager role, or 3–4 years for the Senior Associate role, in financial services, consulting, business development, or relationship management. Strong relationship management and communication skills, with experience developing institutional partnerships, identifying opportunities, and delivering excellent client or member service. Good understanding of finance and capital markets, with an interest in blended finance and investment in emerging and frontier markets. Ability to use data and user feedback to improve services and engagement; experience growing digital platforms or developing partnerships is an asset. An entrepreneurial approach, with strong project management skills and the confidence to work independently, supported by a collaborative global team and flexibility to shape approaches and contribute new ideas. Comfortable using AI and digital tools to improve efficiency, collaboration, and project delivery. Professional fluency in English and Spanish, with willingness to collaborate across time zones and travel periodically to Toronto for team collaboration. APLICATION Interested and qualified applicants are encouraged to apply early and in advance of the application deadline of 5:00 p.m. (ET) on November 23, 2026 . Please note that due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact those selected for interviews.

Thoughtfully designed with an eclectic-elegant atmosphere, our hotels are built to evoke extraordinary feelings — paying great attention to stimulating details that create truly memorable moments. We welcome business travellers, friends, and couples seeking premium service, and we craft experiences centred on wellbeing, gastronomy, culture, and pure indulgence. If you are passionate about creating those extraordinary moments for every guest, NH Collection is the place to do it. Feel the extraordinary. Job Description & Requirements Russia Market Drive leisure, wholesale and luxury travel agency sales from Russia, with clear production targets per account. Develop and manage strategic relationships with leading Russian tour operators, luxury travel agencies and travel advisors. Plan and execute market activity including sales missions, roadshows, trade fairs agent training and client events. Maximise production during key Russian travel periods such as the New Year holidays and the May holidays and promote longer stays and family travel. Ensure Russian language sales materials are available, and that guest preferences are communicated to Operations. Ensure all contracting and payment arrangements comply with company policy and applicable regulations, working closely with Finance. Middle East Market Development Prepare a Middle East market entry plan, including target countries, segments, partners, activity calendar and revenue targets, for approval by the Director of Sales & Marketing. Identify, contact and activate luxury travel agencies, tour operators, concierge and VIP travel services, and corporate travel desks across the GCC. Represent the resort at key regional events. Position the resort for Middle East traveller priorities such as privacy, multi-bedroom and family villas, halal dining, and travel around Eid and the summer school holidays, using GCC demand to support need periods. Work with airline partners serving the Maldives from the Gulf on joint promotions, and with Marketing on Arabic-language sales materials. Work with Operations to ensure the resort is ready for Middle East guests, including dining, prayer facilities and cultural service standards. Report regularly on market development progress, partner pipeline and conversion. Work together with both Russia and ME GSOs to maximise the ROI for the resort. General Sales Responsibilities Ensure that you fully understand the business strategy and positioning of the NH Collection brand, so that you are able to articulate this positioning effectively in the marketplace. Maintain up-to-date personal knowledge of NH Collection Maldives Reethi Resort and its service offerings, the products, services, rates and new developments of key competitors, and general industry trends. Collaborate closely with Revenue Management to ensure optimal pricing, inventory control and market segmentation. Monitor competitor resorts and market trends to maintain strong positioning within the luxury Maldives segment. Approach personal sales activities from a strategic perspective, understanding the relative importance and priority of the current account base, and directing personal sales efforts accordingly. Continually review the actual production of each account against its potential, and review suggestions for improvement with department leadership. Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, action plans and performance reports aligned with resort revenue goals. Conduct site inspections and familiarisation trips, showcasing the resort’s villas, experiences, dining and sustainability initiatives. Coordinate with Marketing, Reservations and Operations to ensure seamless conversion and guest experience delivery. Liaise effectively with all operational colleagues, providing support and information to ensure accurate delivery of our promise. Drive opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Minor Hotels products. Practise effective cost control and adhere to internal procedures for the approval of expenditure. Maintain full working knowledge of the IT tools used in sales today, including the CRM and sales software, the property PMS and the Microsoft Office toolset, and keep all account records up to date. Ensure that all administration is processed quickly and efficiently. Achieve personal financial and non-financial performance objectives, working with department leadership to ensure these objectives are met. Take responsibility for your own professional development, ensuring that you have the financial literacy, negotiation and face-to-face selling skills needed to do your job successfully. Represent Minor Hotels in a professional and brand-consistent manner at all times. Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
